title: Index of Refraction
description: Essential Criteria: The correct calculation of the index of refraction n must be provided.

title: Reflective Efficiency
description: Essential Criteria: The calculation of the retro-reflectance efficiency eta must be included.

title: Focal Length Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The derivation of the focal length f and its relation to the radius r should be shown.

title: Qualitative Discussion
description: Important Criteria: A qualitative discussion of factors affecting reflective efficiency should be included.

title: Transparency Calculation
description: Optional Criteria: The calculation of transparency T should be presented as part of the efficiency derivation.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors such as sign mistakes in calculations should be avoided.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
